name: arbor
description: Arbor — personal agent plugin kit. First plugin: dual-review-loop, a bounded dual-review convergence loop for code changes.

plugins.name: dual-review-loop
plugins.description: Two independent fresh-context read-only reviewers (correctness + structure) review the same frozen change scope in parallel; the main agent fixes actionable blockers, runs project validation, and fresh reviewers re-review the full scope until convergence or a bounded stop.
